+1. A server-side SYSTEM command registers `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` with fixture/spec ID **and version** (authored P01 and P02) or `REGISTERED_SIMULATION` with server-recorded run ID, immutable run identity/digest, registered `SIMULATED` gateway, and proof the exact batch came from that run. Both pin tenant/Site UUID, gateway/source, external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, immutable publication ID, server-resolved principal, authorization basis, channel, trigger and recorded time. Private scenario truth stays outside product evidence. `SIMULATED`/`LIVE`, credential, client text, Site/day match or private manifest alone confers no designation. No public designation route.
+2. Registration and `open_batch` take the **same transaction-scoped advisory lock** on the scoped tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch key and check admission under it. Identical retries return the same ID; changed content or publication-ID reuse fails. Registration after *any* admission, including partial admission, fails. `open_batch` binds only the exact preauthorized digest/identity commitment in its admission transaction; matching key with mismatched commitment fails rather than downgrading to unknown. Unpublished upload remains accepted with unknown source. Accepted IDs inherit immutable batch linkage across chunk restart; duplicate disposition retains its original accepted ID/provenance; rejected/conflict rows acquire none. No retroactive assignment or Site/day backfill.
+3. Resolve each selected FindingRevision's immutable cited accepted-ID set. Resolve each consequence revision separately from the union of that FindingRevision set and **its own quantified power-interval accepted IDs**. Return `finding_revision_id`, `consequence_revision_id` where applicable, exact cited/power/union IDs, per-evidence `accepted_evidence_id`, `batch_id`, `publication_id`, `source_class`, fixture ID/version or run ID/basis, all distinct publication IDs, `problematic_accepted_evidence_ids`, state and typed reasons. Historical revisions retain their own state.
 
-## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.
+4. Authored and registered-simulation sets can show current money only after **all** LR eligibility, exact selected Finding/consequence basis, currentness, source-open, quantity and price gates pass. Show `Demonstration data` or `Simulated data` respectively. `MIXED`/`UNKNOWN` block current amount on all three money reads; expose `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` alongside every other failed typed gate. Old amount is audit-only with exact revision, source state and limitation; unknown means neither physical measurement nor zero cost. Later `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` may qualify only a coherent fully attested cited set subject to the same gates.
+5. S5-01 packet amendment is mandatory in **whichever of S4-05b and S5-01 merges second**: replace `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39`'s `demonstration_case`/unreadable-spec trigger with stored exact-revision provenance; add authored, registered-simulation, mixed, unknown and later attested-real classes; apply `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` for mixed/unknown regardless of spec readability, including consequence-only power; preserve IDs and simultaneous reasons. Update P01/P02, positively bound ordinary simulation and unbound-history walkthrough expectations. Source class does not influence S5 Finding choice. Compose at LR-01's `financials/money_eligibility.py` and `finding_api.py:347` bridge after its merge; re-chain migration from the then-current single head (LR-01 may take 0014/0015, making this 0016).

Identical retries return the same ID; changed content or publication-ID reuse fails. Registration after *any* admission, including partial admission, fails. `open_batch` binds only the exact preauthorized digest/identity commitment in its admission transaction; matching key with mismatched commitment fails rather than downgrading to unknown. Unpublished upload remains accepted with unknown source. Accepted IDs inherit immutable batch linkage across chunk restart; duplicate disposition retains its original accepted ID/provenance; rejected/conflict rows acquire none. No retroactive assignment or Site/day backfill.
+3. Resolve each selected FindingRevision's immutable cited accepted-ID set. Resolve each consequence revision separately from the union of that FindingRevision set and **its own quantified power-interval accepted IDs**. Return `finding_revision_id`, `consequence_revision_id` where applicable, exact cited/power/union IDs, per-evidence `accepted_evidence_id`, `batch_id`, `publication_id`, `source_class`, fixture ID/version or run ID/basis, all distinct publication IDs, `problematic_accepted_evidence_ids`, state and typed reasons. Historical revisions retain their own state.
 
-## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.
+4. Authored and registered-simulation sets can show current money only after **all** LR eligibility, exact selected Finding/consequence basis, currentness, source-open, quantity and price gates pass. Show `Demonstration data` or `Simulated data` respectively. `MIXED`/`UNKNOWN` block current amount on all three money reads; expose `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` alongside every other failed typed gate. Old amount is audit-only with exact revision, source state and limitation; unknown means neither physical measurement nor zero cost. Later `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` may qualify only a coherent fully attested cited set subject to the same gates.
+5. S5-01 packet amendment is mandatory in **whichever of S4-05b and S5-01 merges second**: replace `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39`'s `demonstration_case`/unreadable-spec trigger with stored exact-revision provenance; add authored, registered-simulation, mixed, unknown and later attested-real classes; apply `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` for mixed/unknown regardless of spec readability, including consequence-only power; preserve IDs and simultaneous reasons. Update P01/P02, positively bound ordinary simulation and unbound-history walkthrough expectations. Source class does not influence S5 Finding choice. Compose at LR-01's `financials/money_eligibility.py` and `finding_api.py:347` bridge after its merge; re-chain migration from the then-current single head (LR-01 may take 0014/0015, making this 0016).

Identical retries return the same ID; changed content or publication-ID reuse fails. Registration after *any* admission, including partial admission, fails. `open_batch` binds only the exact preauthorized digest/identity commitment in its admission transaction; matching key with mismatched commitment fails rather than downgrading to unknown. Unpublished upload remains accepted with unknown source. Accepted IDs inherit immutable batch linkage across chunk restart; duplicate disposition retains its original accepted ID/provenance; rejected/conflict rows acquire none. No retroactive assignment or Site/day backfill.
+3. Resolve each selected FindingRevision's immutable cited accepted-ID set. Resolve each consequence revision separately from the union of that FindingRevision set and **its own quantified power-interval accepted IDs**. Return `finding_revision_id`, `consequence_revision_id` where applicable, exact cited/power/union IDs, per-evidence `accepted_evidence_id`, `batch_id`, `publication_id`, `source_class`, fixture ID/version or run ID/basis, all distinct publication IDs, `problematic_accepted_evidence_ids`, state and typed reasons. Historical revisions retain their own state.
 
-## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.
+4. Authored and registered-simulation sets can show current money only after **all** LR eligibility, exact selected Finding/consequence basis, currentness, source-open, quantity and price gates pass. Show `Demonstration data` or `Simulated data` respectively. `MIXED`/`UNKNOWN` block current amount on all three money reads; expose `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` alongside every other failed typed gate. Old amount is audit-only with exact revision, source state and limitation; unknown means neither physical measurement nor zero cost. Later `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` may qualify only a coherent fully attested cited set subject to the same gates.
+5. S5-01 packet amendment is mandatory in **whichever of S4-05b and S5-01 merges second**: replace `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39`'s `demonstration_case`/unreadable-spec trigger with stored exact-revision provenance; add authored, registered-simulation, mixed, unknown and later attested-real classes; apply `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` for mixed/unknown regardless of spec readability, including consequence-only power; preserve IDs and simultaneous reasons. Update P01/P02, positively bound ordinary simulation and unbound-history walkthrough expectations. Source class does not influence S5 Finding choice. Compose at LR-01's `financials/money_eligibility.py` and `finding_api.py:347` bridge after its merge; re-chain migration from the then-current single head (LR-01 may take 0014/0015, making this 0016).

+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |

It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.

-## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.
+4. Authored and registered-simulation sets can show current money only after **all** LR eligibility, exact selected Finding/consequence basis, currentness, source-open, quantity and price gates pass. Show `Demonstration data` or `Simulated data` respectively. `MIXED`/`UNKNOWN` block current amount on all three money reads; expose `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` alongside every other failed typed gate. -## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. -## Implementation contract
+| Scoped citation set | State / reason |
+| --- | --- |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to authored publications with same fixture ID/version, including several publication IDs | `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; list every publication ID |
+| Nonempty; every ID bound to one run, or several runs with explicitly recorded compatible run basis | `REGISTERED_SIMULATION`; list run/publication IDs |
+| Different authored fixture/version; incompatible runs; crossed classes; bound and unbound mixed; consequence-only power conflicts | `MIXED` with exact IDs and basis reason |
+| Empty; no positive binding; missing, foreign-Site or broken accepted-ID/publication link | `UNKNOWN` with exact IDs/reasons; broken link precedes `MIXED` |
 
-1. **Publication, before upload (new).** Add migration `0014` from main's `0013_schedule_state` head for an append-only `evidence_publication` table and a scoped immutable batch-publication binding (either a nullable `ingestion_batch.publication_id` or a one-to-one insert-only link). Publication has UUID ID; tenant/Site UUID; external batch ID, canonical Batch V2 payload SHA-256, gateway/source IDs; designation `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION`; fixture/spec ID and version; server-resolved `actor_kind=SYSTEM`, stable service principal, authorization basis, source channel, triggering job/fixture ID, and server `recorded_at`. Use composite tenant/Site FKs, unique publication identity and unique exact batch commitment; prohibit update/delete or conflicting reuse. A real/live assertion is **not** inferred from absence of designation or `source_mode=LIVE`.
-2. **Authorization (new).** Expose only a server-side administrative SYSTEM fixture/CLI command with fixed service principal and explicit configured allowlist/authorization basis, modelled on `publish_assumption.py`; no public gateway or browser write route. It must validate fixture/spec identity/version and canonical batch digest against the exact payload, then insert the publication through an extension of `PostgresEvidenceLedger`. No `--actor`, `--author` or client-supplied provenance text can become authority. Refuse wrong tenant/Site, gateway/source, missing or conflicting batch digest, publication ID reuse with changed content, and publication after any batch admission. An identical retry returns the same publication. Registration and subsequent `open_batch` must serialize for the same scoped batch key so ingestion cannot race an after-the-fact designation. The upload remains valid without designation but has `UNKNOWN` authorship.
-3. **Accepted binding (new).** `open_batch` matches only the preauthorized exact tenant/Site/gateway/source/external-batch-ID/digest commitment. The accepted evidence already references the scoped batch (`0005:165,197-200`); expose the immutable publication ID per **accepted evidence ID** through that link, including interrupted/resumed chunks. A duplicate disposition retains the original accepted ID and its original provenance; it cannot relabel old evidence. Rejected/conflict rows confer no provenance. No retroactive assignment or mutable backfill of historic accepted rows. Fail the upload if a matching publication conflicts; never silently downgrade a claimed publication to unknown.
-4. **Read and amount rules (new).** Resolve every cited accepted ID under the requested tenant/Site, returning publication ID, designation and fixture/spec version per record plus a set-level state: `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION` only when every relevant cited ID is bound to a consistent authored publication basis; `MIXED` when some cited IDs have that designation and others have no designation or a different basis; `UNKNOWN` when none is designated or any cited ID/link cannot be resolved (and retain exact problematic IDs). A broken link takes precedence over `MIXED`. A FindingRevision uses its immutable cited set, not an episode date. A consequence uses its **own** quantified power-interval evidence IDs as well as the selected FindingRevision cited set; a later revision can differ. Preserve historical revision-specific results; do not relabel a historical revision from the current head. Mixed/unknown reads say “Source not confirmed” with exact IDs and show no current amount wherever this source gate is used. Preserve `tasks/S5-01-site-overview.md:39-41` no-amount rule when its branch merges. Keep existing “Demonstration data” wording for fully authored P01; propose concise mixed/unknown copy to owner at checkpoint. Remove runtime calls to `demonstration_case` and its date/spec cache; retain its old test only as regression proving same-day real/unknown is not labelled authored.
-5. **Writer and migration boundary.** Extend the existing ledger writer's allowed tables in rule 8 (`configuration-persistence.ps1:624-625`); require INSERT only for publication/link rows, and prevent ledger or other writers from UPDATE/DELETE of these immutable rows. Preserve all eight existing writer allowlists, reverse ownership and driver non-vacuity. Add guard probes for permitted ledger INSERT, forbidden other-writer INSERT, mutation, omitted writer/import, and client route attempting designation. If LR-01 merges first and contributes migrations 0014/0015 on its branch, re-chain this migration to the new head and renumber it; never create a parallel head. Recheck S5-01 read composition after its merge without stacking this task on that unmerged branch.
+4. Authored and registered-simulation sets can show current money only after **all** LR eligibility, exact selected Finding/consequence basis, currentness, source-open, quantity and price gates pass. Show `Demonstration data` or `Simulated data` respectively. `MIXED`/`UNKNOWN` block current amount on all three money reads; expose `MIXED_OR_UNKNOWN_SOURCE` alongside every other failed typed gate. Old amount is audit-only with exact revision, source state and limitation; unknown means neither physical measurement nor zero cost. Later `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` may qualify only a coherent fully attested cited set subject to the same gates.
